title: [CQ-V01] Protected required check definitions
description:
Objective: Define approved check references/digests covering commands, configs, scripts and protected assertion roots.

Deliverable: Protected required check definitions. This is task V01 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): F03.

rejectionHistory.reason:
REJECT for two reasons: the diff is oversized, and one planned behaviour is untested. No DoD behaviour failed.

1) SIZE: completion dc13b0e changes +466/-19 = 447 net LOC under packages/ (about 190 production, the rest tests). That is over the 400 cap, and no project, epic or task rail waives size-based rejection. CQ-V01b (net 422) was approved without a waiver, which is not a rail, so the inconsistency should be settled by a rail.

2) TEST GAP: step 4 promised that deliveryProjection.requiredCheckSatisfied reads false on protected-checks-unmeasured, and no test pins this. A QA mutant that drops that clause (deliveryProjection.ts:89) passes the whole suite, so a client would show "satisfied" while the protected files were never measured.

Everything else was verified and is sound:
- dc13b0e is on moe/work-2026-10-24.
- A fresh full-repo git archive (native Linux deps, env -i) gives npm test exit 0 (159 files, 3750 passed / 15 skipped) and tsc --noEmit exit 0.
- DoD 1-3 each have exact toEqual tests on real submit_plan measurement.
- QA's own mutants: 6 of 7 were killed (ignore-added, any-command, no '/' boundary, missing-as-match, no-snapshot-ok, replay compare). The survivor is #2 above.

ROUTE: the bytes have already landed, so do NOT re-slice. Follow the R06/R07 precedent:
- The architect proposes an epic rail exception naming dc13b0e (+466/-19, net 447) that may grow only by the QA fix below.
- The worker adds the single assertion, then re-runs `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` fresh.
